verdict.rationale: Meilisearch markets instant results even when users only remember part of a query (docs-60) and fast full-text search (docs-1), and it pairs with React InstantSearch for responsive type-ahead interfaces (docs-72); a dedicated facet-search endpoint powers type-ahead on filters (docs-27). Community users corroborate fast search at scale and compare it to self-hosted Algolia (comm-10, comm-15, comm-14, comm-4). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of prefix/search-as-you-type behavior on the main search endpoint, and concrete millisecond latency figures for keyword search.
